title: gate_request
description: Schema for gate_request_NNNN_M.json artefacts produced by the Path A gate broker (Initiative_Orchestrator_Spec_v1_4 §10.3 step 1). Phase 4a P4-06. NOTE (updated 2026-05-27 by FUP-0749): options.items accepts both string AND object shapes (anyOf) — the rl-initiative-planner emits {id,label,consequence} objects per IOS §10.3 step 1 (each option carries an identifier, a human-readable label, and a consequence description). Legacy synthetic-fixture shape (string options) retained for backward-compat. Mirrors the accept-both pattern used in execution_result.schema.json (FUP-0734 / FUP-0737). Do NOT re-tighten without re-verifying against current Planner emission shape.

gate_id.description: Stable identifier for the gate, used by seed.gate_policy.pre_classification[].pattern matching.

question_text.description: The full question posed to the operator (or rl-operator-answerer) in natural language.

options.description: Enumerated answer choices. anyOf {string | {id, label?, consequence?}} — Planner emits objects per IOS §10.3 step 1; synthetic-fixture shape (string) accepted for backward-compat.

cluster.description: Optional cluster tag for pre-classification (consumed by §10.2 cluster: pattern form).

context.description: Optional free-form context preceding the question (string) or structured context object emitted by the Executor.

iteration.description: Optional iteration number this gate was raised in.
